results.title: General Jam Issues - Spotify Community
results.content: This behavior is incredibly frustrating, especially since it tends to behave itself only when we let the playlist continue on "as written" and don't add anything to the queue, particularly after it becomes unstable. This is boring and rather defeats the purpose of this feature for us. During my time-consuming crawl through the community, I have seen rather old posts with facets of this behavior that either go unresolved (though usually with plenty of responses) or were supposedly fixed in a code patch years ago. It is fascinating to experience some of these previously posted behaviors as if there were a regression in the code, yet see no corresponding increase in posts about it. Unfortunately for us, this probably indicates a more localized cause of our issue, though the consistency of it [...] 4. Occasionally if you add a song to the queue, move a song in the queue, or really interact with any real song related to anything while in a jam the song will restart over and over and over again every time you do this but the same behavior will occur where Spotify seems to attempt to "catch up" and will cut the song after the time passes where the song was "supposed" to end. This will switch from happening to one user where they will be significantly off from the rest of the listeners and just hearing the song keeps restarting every time an action is done or will occasionally affect all jam participants. [...] a method that consistently works to fully restabilize a failing Jam.
